purpose: Source/input/assertion catalog for twelve direct settings parser, text-transformation and display scalar predicates; not a runtime manifest, execution result, reference selection or baseline acceptance.

hash_conventions.body: Inclusive function signature through closing brace, LF, no trailing LF
hash_conventions.finite_case: Sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON (ensure_ascii=false), excluding source and self hash

shared.RNG: No explicit seeding, draw-count or RNG-state equality assertion in selected cases. Parsing random mode is not running the generator.
shared.purity: Selected case paths parse/update in-memory text or compute scalar values; no file access/window/device/controller/reset/save/restart API. Test executable startup/diagnostic allocation/CRT work is separate harness behavior.

registration.dispatch: One named existing case per CTest process, unconditionally registered when tests enabled.
registration.main: Settings main returns tests::run only. Display main calls SetErrorMode, BaseInit, tests::run, BaseDeInit. Neither has the explicit final MEM_SPY scan present in queue/host tests.
registration.checks: MG_CHECK remains active in Release; optional MSVC Debug CRT configuration belongs to shared support.

limits: Whole Values equality is asserted here; no RNG draw counter or effective game setting is observed.

Later calls do not reassert all size/other fields. No actual window mode switch.
Invalid-width loop checks width and mode fallback only, not full Settings equality. Parser bounds are not tested exhaustively.
Four scalar calls only; no shortcut/window/controller transition.
Midpoint is the inclusive integer range383..384, not an exact coordinate. Outside assertions preserve only signs/bounds, not exact values. No cursor/OS/viewport dispatch.
